title: Project configuration — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of the project's `.pkit/capabilities/visual-communication/project/config.yaml` (DEC-002 point 2): the project's choices as a whole. `location` is the working folder that holds the project's libraries and pieces, recorded by the command that first writes there (COR-049 point 5); absent, the commands take `visual/` at the repository's top. Never a look, a lock or a choice of one piece. Format 1 holds the location alone; turning on plugins that reach a service comes later. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:config`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

location.description: The location, a folder within the repository, relative to its top.
